startup.view: Australia, north-up, zero pitch, geographic bounds framed to the viewport
startup.content: Sleeping Geo, Segoe UI Emoji, native colours, 2D, Small, Adelaide anchor
startup.surveyBaseline: Newest stored Object ID establishes the cursor without replaying its content or command
startup.polling: Anonymous, one second; newly empty feeds use cursor zero

commands.parsing: Trimmed, case-insensitive Begin/Reset; commands override other fields in their submission
commands.begin: Draw and await sleeping Geo's own source frame, fly to shared geometry-based close Fit over 15000ms, then release queued cues
commands.reset: Invalidate older render/camera operations, discard preceding queued cues, restore opening defaults and anchor, jump to Australia, continue polling

scenarios: Modular startup with an empty view
Portable startup with historical commands and content
Actual 15-second flight, draw-before-flight ordering, queued content and duplicate Begin
Delayed sleeping-emoji face waits before flight
Reset interrupts a flight without stale camera movement
Reset does not wait for a superseded font model
Reset stops Orbit, Turn and Face and restores defaults
Leaving Map during Begin allows a subsequent Begin after polling resumes
Overview suppresses automatic framing and animation
Reduced motion and different viewport sizes
Existing message, Random, Fit, rendering, anchoring and other workflow checks

validationBoundary: Survey and tile responses are mocked in browser tests; no survey records or service configuration were changed.
